name: Cubing in Venteira 2025
information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58282-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58283-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58286-associados-aps-aps-associates). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58282-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58283-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubinginVenteira2025#58286-associados-aps-aps-associates). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4MTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2c5df1434148e36097ff9324d0447c32fb59563b/cubing-in-venteira-logo.png) ​ **Espetadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!**
